米娅与酒店的计划(Mia and the the hotel Plan): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:米娅与莉莉的经历和小计划。
Lily's birthday is in April. Mia hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Mia usually has soup for breakfast. The movie is about a stripper who becomes a singer.
Mia borrowed a book about history from the library. Mia learned a lot about history. There are always many people at the hotel. The old furnace heats the whole building in winter.
Mia wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was sunny that day. Lily is interested in cooking. Best of all, lost luggage turned up two days later.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus stop by bike. Last Monday, Mia and Lily went to the bus stop. Life is full of small surprises.
